title: Windowed alerts instead of single readings

problem.title: The problem today
points: Every reading above 5 °C raises an alert
Door openings cause hundreds of false alarms
Dispatchers mute the channel during peaks

solution.title: The solution: five-minute windows
solution.text: Dataflow averages readings in sliding five-minute windows and alerts only when the window stays above the threshold, so short door openings no longer page anyone.

code:
-- Dataflow SQL: sliding window per truck
SELECT truck_id, AVG(temp_c) AS avg_temp
FROM pubsub.topic.`reefer-readings`
GROUP BY truck_id,
  HOP(event_ts, "INTERVAL 1 MINUTE", "INTERVAL 5 MINUTE")
HAVING AVG(temp_c) > 5.0
note: Threshold and window length are set per product class in the alert configuration table.

tips.title: Why per-class windows
points: Frozen loads tolerate short door openings
Windows are tuned in the pilot
